abstract: Let $J_0^D(M)$ be the Jacobian of the Shimura curve $X_0^D(M)$, $D>1$, of genus $g$, and $N=DM$. The companion paper (rStation math_4) proved $h_F(J_0^D(M))\ge(\frac13-o(1))\,g\log N$ for squarefree $N$ prime to $6$. This does not cover all levels used in Pasten's Shimura-curve approach to abc, where $2^r$ ($r\le8$) and $3$ may divide $N$. We remove the restriction for bounded $2$-part: if $M=M_0 2^r3^s$ with $M_0$ squarefree and prime to $6D$, $r\le r_0$, $s\le1$, and $2,3$ allowed to divide $D$ (including $D=6$), then $12\,h_F(J/\mathbf Q)\ge4(g-1)[\sum_{q\mid D,q\ge5}\frac q{q-1}\log q+\sum_{q\mid D,q\le3}\frac{3q-1}{4(q-1)}\log q+\sum_{p\mid M_0}\frac p{p+1}\log p]-C_{r_0}(g+2^{\omega(N)}\log N)$, hence $h_F\ge(\frac13-o_{r_0}(1))\,g\log N$ uniformly. At $2$ and $3$ the models are neither semistable nor normal after base change, and elliptic sections can meet singular points. Instead of computing these fibres we prove that the completed local rings, with group action, forgetful map and elliptic germs, have finitely many isomorphism types, and we use three sign facts: the Artin conductor is non-negative, $\pi^*L\cdot V\ge0$, and $V^2$ is bounded below. As a consequence, the lattice ceiling and the model-relative obstruction of the companion paper extend to all factorizations in Pasten's Theorem 16.7, so to all abc triples with many prime factors: inside the stated relaxation model the Petersson-ratio channel has exponent at least $2/3$. We claim nothing about the stable height, which is left open, and nothing about the abc conjecture.
author: lihongmin
change_summary:
- Data availability and supplement: replaced the Verification section with Data availability and added a self-contained standard-library Python verification package (supplement.zip: checks_math5.py, README.md, CONTENTS.sha256) checking the mod-8 matrix congruence for Gamma_z cap K_1 = 1 and PGL_2(F_p) fixed-point counts in Section 2.4, the exact rational coefficient identities and non-squarefree degree bound d_M >= phi(N)/6 across all four divisibility classes gcd(D,6) in {1,2,3,6}, the Katz-Mazur component multiplicities m_{a,b} = phi(p^{min(a,b)}), and the admissibility of all Pasten Theorem 16.7 factorizations under Theorem A with r_0 = 8.
- Corollary 1.2, Section 2.1, Section 2.3, Lemma 3.1, and Section 5: made the step psi(p^k) >= phi(p^k) => d_M >= phi(N)/6 explicit in the proof of Corollary 1.2, corrected the reference for the endomorphism ring of quasi-canonical liftings of level s >= 1 to Gross [5, Section 5, (5.2) and Proposition 5.3], and added Katz-Mazur [16, Theorem 5.1.1, Theorems 6.6.1-6.6.2] and Raynaud [17, Théorèmes 8.1.4 and 8.2.1].
- Companion and external references, author line, and metadata abstract: updated the companion reference [1] (math_4) from version 3 to version 5, cited Stewart-Yu [10, Theorem 1], Pasten [8, Theorem 1.4], and Pasten's congruence-module bound [20, Theorem 1.1, Corollary 1.3] in Problem and contribution and Section 6, completed volume, issue, page numbers, and DOIs in References [2]-[20], and standardized the author line and metadata abstract.
title: Faltings heights of Shimura curve Jacobians at levels divisible by 2 and 3
